answer: Charge every would-be identity a slow-release capital bond: an agent must lock POA behind a vesting curve before its attestations count, so a sybil nebula of ten thousand clones now demands ten thousand real deposits, and any caught fraud forfeits them all. A zephyr-cheap fake can echo good behavior like a fable repeated until it sounds true, but it cannot echo locked capital — that is the one cost a clone cannot share.
